mapper.select: select * from user where username=#{username} limit 1
select * from user where id=#{id} limit 1
mapper.update: update user set username = #{user.username}, password = #{user.password}, nickname = #{user.nickname}, avatar = #{user.avatar}, email = #{user.email}, update_time = now() where username = #{username}
mapper.insert: insert into user (username, password, nickname, avatar, email, create_time, update_time, role) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{email}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{role})
